summary.zh: 为服务生成部署、故障处理、维护与回滚手册
summary.en: Write runbooks for deploy, incidents, maintenance and rollback.

description.zh: 按环境为服务编写操作手册，覆盖部署、故障响应、例行维护和回滚步骤。适合服务上线前补齐运维文档，或交接给值班同学时使用。手册内容需要结合实际的部署方式校准。
description.en: Writes per-environment runbooks for deploy, incident response, maintenance and rollback. Use it before launch to fill doc gaps, or when handing a service to whoever is on call. Steps need checking against how you deploy.
